stemMd: Which complete order satisfies every stated condition?
explanationMd: Check each rule against Power → Load → Seal → Noise → Temperature. Every precedence, position, and separation condition holds. Each alternative violates at least one explicit rule; the corresponding violated condition is identified in its feedback.

distractorRationale.d: This order violates: Noise must be immediately followed by Temperature. Exactly 1 other item must occur between Power and Seal.
distractorRationale.c: This order violates: Noise must be immediately followed by Temperature. Load must precede Seal. Exactly 1 other item must occur between Power and Seal.
distractorRationale.a: This order violates: Noise must be immediately followed by Temperature. Load must precede Seal.
